sourceSnapshot.arabicExcerpt: والثلث فرض أم ليس لميتها ولد ولا ولد ابن ولا اثنان من الإخوة والأخوات، وفرض اثنين فأكثر من ولد الأم.
sourceSnapshot.sourceSummary: One third is assigned to the mother under the stated absence conditions and collectively to two or more uterine siblings.

arabicCorrections.note: The excerpt matches the first two clauses, but the visible source continues: «وقد يفرض للجد مع الإخوة». That continuation must be preserved as a separate grandfather-with-siblings matter, not folded into the ordinary one-third rule.

explicitConditions: Mother: the deceased has no child, no son's descendant, and not two siblings. Uterine siblings: two or more.
explicitExclusions: The line is not a complete implementation rule for the mother because the Umariyyatayn and sibling-count details occur elsewhere. The grandfather continuation is a special-case reference requiring its dedicated section.
explicitOutcome: Under the stated ordinary conditions, the mother receives one third; two or more uterine siblings collectively receive one third.
